attempts.summary: Established BRANCH.TEST on node1 and deployed the reports/node2.branch.test application keytab to node2. A post-reboot analyst ticket was cryptographically validated by node2’s keytab. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing, SSH access, and unchanged ownership notes.
